measures: how FortyGuard's spatially-uniform forecast LEVEL offset varies with lead, on the one day where five leads were purchased
does_not_measure: coverage. That needs several days at a short lead, which needs live forecast access. This is a single day (2026-08-12).
why: N-26's live coverage failed at 65.6 % pooled / 0.0 % worst day because the forecast error is a day-level offset that flips sign; shortening the lead is the proposed fix
verdict: SHORTENING THE LEAD IS NOT THE FIX: the offset does not shrink (-0.8396 C at 9.41 h vs -1.0177 C at 1.49 h). The level error is not a lead-time artefact, so a short-lead bound would fail the same way. Do NOT spend credits on a short-lead coverage test on this basis.
